confidential: Before every test, each tester agrees to keep what they see confidential.
Testers agree to take screenshots only inside the report, and never to share them anywhere else.
Standard and Launch Ready can add your own NDA, which testers accept before they start.
Screenshots are stored privately: only you and our team can see them.
rules: Testnets or fresh, empty wallets only. Never real funds.
Testers never enter a recovery phrase, and stop and report anything that asks for one.

who.title: Who runs this
who.name: Run by Aki, building in web3 since 2019
who.line: I test every product myself before it goes to players, and I read every report before you do.

faq.q: How are testers chosen and checked?
faq.a: Testers are web3.toys players aged 18 or over with Explorer rank, which means they passed at least two of our quizzes. Before every test they accept the safety and confidentiality rules. Every task is timed, and we review each test before it counts: rushed or copied tests are rejected and replaced.

faq.q: What if too few testers join?
faq.a: If fewer testers finish than your tier promises, we extend the test until they do, or refund the difference. You choose.
Quick Test about 5 days, Standard about a week, Launch Ready about 2 weeks including a retest of your fixes. The clock starts after the setup call.
Your deposit is refunded in full if we decline your project after vetting. Once your test is running, the guarantee above applies.

faq.q: What do you need from us?
faq.a: A link testers can use (testnet or staging), test tokens or a faucet if your product needs them, and 15 minutes on a call to agree the tasks. We write the tasks with you.

faq.q: Can we use our own NDA?
faq.a: Yes, on Standard and Launch Ready. Send it before the test opens and every tester accepts it before they start.
